title: [IMP-6] CID computation and the Space genesis self-reference are undefined
description: Review finding IMP-6: CID computation and the Space genesis self-reference are undefined (lens IMP). Location: spec/13-encoding.md:27 (not :91); spec/01-overview.md:43; spec/99-appendices.md:12; spec/03-spaces.md:36, :49, :55. Fix: As proposed. Grep for multicodec/multihash/sha2-256/base32 finds nothing. 01:43 and 99:12 say "dag-cbor", but 13:21 says envelopes are non-canonical CBOR maps, so they are not valid dag-cbor. Also fix 01:43 and 99:12 to the chosen codec. Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
